scene: One shared scene in every container: canvas 800x600, the 3-segment 'Tripod' figure (lengths 50/30/16, segment 3 a circle), red colour override, frame 0 root (111, 222), frame 1 root (121, 222). 'figures' lists the custom figures only; every .piv also implies the format's built-in slot-1 figure.

figure.stk.notes: The legacy STK container stores no name, canvas, fps or frames. The original's decoder reports the figure name as the file stem ('figure'); the geometry is the same Tripod (lengths 50/30/16, segment 3 a circle).

figure.nodes.notes: The original suite's modernNodesBase64 corpus figure (431/117). The container stores no canvas or fps; the values above are the importing project's: a fixed 960x720 stage, 24 fps, the figure at rest at the stage centre. Two segments (root + one child, id 7, length 80, thickness 4); the imported definition has one extra origin node.

project.nodemc.notes: Built by the original test suite's syntheticClip helper (431/117) around the figure.nodes rig, 389 bytes. The clip is named 'Synthetic clip'; its only frame holds no instances, so it imports with zero figures and no poses.
